package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	cfg "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/ecmascript/control_flow_graph"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var counts []int
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &counts); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	cfg.AdamicNewBlockTrace(counts)
}
